newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange quiet, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange quiet, prices mixed.

text.p: Trade on the Istanbul gold exchange was quiet on Wednesday as volume eased to 537 kilos from Tuesday's 627 kilos with banks inactive on the market and low physical demand, one dealer said.
"The banks were pretty inactive today with few opportunities for arbitrage. What trade there was, was due to physical demand, and that was quiet too," one bank dealer said.
Gold was closed easier in dollar terms at $343.80 an ounce compared to $345.00 on Wednesday following falling levels on European markets. No dollar deals were made in the afternoon session.
But gold firmed slightly in lira terms to 1,591,000 per gram versus 1,589,500 as the lira fell against the dollar.
The Turkish currency weakened to 143,550 to the dollar from Tuesday's close of 143,200, helping the rise in gold's lira price.
Almost all the day's trade -- 507 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 79.5 percent of trade conducted in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
